info.title: Encodian - Image Universal API
info.description: Manipulate, transform, optimize, watermark, inspect, and extract text from images using Encodian Flowr Image actions.

post.description: Creates an image with an image watermark in Encodian - Image.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

filename.description: The filename of the source file. The file extension is mandatory, such as file.png.

fileContent.description: Base64 content of the source image file.

watermarkFilename.description: The filename of the watermark image file. The file extension is mandatory.

watermarkFileContent.description: Base64 content of the watermark image file.

watermarkPosition.description: The position of the image watermark on the source image.

imageYOffSet.description: Vertical watermark offset in pixels when Watermark Position is Custom.

imageXOffset.description: Horizontal watermark offset in pixels when Watermark Position is Custom.

rotationAngle.description: Rotation angle for the watermark image in degrees.

opacity.description: Watermark opacity from 0.0 to 1.0. Default is 0.7.

alignImage.description: Align the source image using EXIF orientation tags.

alignWatermark.description: Align the watermark image using EXIF orientation tags.

FileContent.description: Base64 content of the processed image.

Filename.description: The filename of the processed image.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

post.description: Creates an image with a text watermark in Encodian - Image.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

fileName.description: The filename of the source image file. The file extension is mandatory.

fileContent.description: Base64 content of the source image file.

text.description: The text to embed as a watermark within the image.

finalOperation.description: Return the processed file content instead of only an operation ID.

watermarkPosition.description: Position of the text watermark within the image.

font.description: Font applied to the text watermark. Default is Arial.

textColour.description: HTML colour for the text watermark. Default is #E81123.

textSize.description: Font size for the text watermark. Default is 10.

operationId.description: Advanced: use a previous Encodian operation ID instead of file content.

FileContent.description: Base64 content of the processed image.

Filename.description: The filename of the processed image.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

post.description: Creates a cleaned-up document image in Encodian - Image.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

fileName.description: The filename of the source image file. The file extension is mandatory.

fileContent.description: Base64 content of the source image file.

finalOperation.description: Return the processed file content instead of only an operation ID.

autoRotateConfidenceLevel.description: Minimum confidence percentage from 0 to 100 used to control whether rotation is applied.

cleanUpType.description: Clean-up mode to apply. Default performs automatic document clean-up; None skips clean-up; Specific uses selected advanced clean-up flags.

autoRotate.description: Automatically detects orientation and rotates the image upright.

deskew.description: Detects the skew angle and rotates to remove that skew.

despeckle.description: Automatically detects speckles and removes them.

adjustBrightnessContrast.description: Automatically adjusts brightness and contrast based on image analysis.

removeBorder.description: Locates and removes border pixels from the document.

smoothBackground.description: Smooths background colors to reduce noise.

smoothObjects.description: Smooths object edges in bitonal documents.

removeDotShading.description: Removes shaded regions from bitonal documents.

imageDetergent.description: Smooths regions by shifting similar color values toward a central value.

applyAverageFilter.description: Applies a 3x3 average filter smoothing operation.

removeHolePunch.description: Detects and removes hole punch marks from a bitonal document.

binarize.description: Binarizes the image for dark text on brighter background documents.

FileContent.description: Base64 content of the processed image.

Filename.description: The filename of the processed image.
